subject.title: feat(skills): scan session history for workshop ideas

question: Should OpenClaw officially support manual Skill Workshop scans that send selected historical session transcripts to the configured model provider and retain provenance/cursor metadata in core SQLite storage?
rationale: The linked issue still carries a product-decision signal, and the feature expands the privacy, persistence, Gateway, and Control UI contract beyond the existing just-completed-run review flow.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded manual scan
options.body: Accept the opt-in provider and storage boundary, then require real UI proof and final upgrade validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Approve only the history-selection and provenance APIs now, leaving the operator-facing scan workflow for a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep historical mining outside the shipped product until a different privacy or ownership model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded manual scan
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in provider and storage boundary, then require real UI proof and final upgrade validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked product proposal and the surrounding Skill Workshop direction.
